content_blocks.label: clause_1._CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: The Disclosing Party hereby discloses Confidential Information to the Receiving Party under the terms of this Agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall not disclose the Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.2_RETENTION
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall retain all Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall not use it for any purpose other than as expressly permitted hereunder.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 20th day of February 2024.
